description: Common auditable-code rules shared by all Styio-family repositories.
required_checklist_markers: Check The Seven Design Principles First
Audit Data Structures, Data Flow, And Lifecycle State Machines
audit_items: Design-principle compliance is checked before local style.
Lifecycle test coverage must be proven with project tools.
Every non-trivial data/resource structure must have an auditable state machine.
Delivery gates are judged by quality protection, not by whether current code passes.
Styio-family repositories must publish Apache-2.0 license evidence and source-distribution obligations.
Styio-family repositories must reject dependencies that require commercial authorization, subscription, or membership-gated access.
Every project module manifest must list its technology stack, internal components, open-source components, and dependency manifests.
Styio-family repositories must not contain passwords, tokens, API keys, private keys, client secrets, or access keys in tracked source or git history.

license_policy.name: Styio Apache-2.0 source license policy
license_policy.license_obligation: Styio-family source code is licensed under Apache-2.0; downstream source-derived tools must preserve required license, copyright, NOTICE, modification, and patent-license notices when distributing covered source or binaries.

commercial_risk_policy.name: Styio no-commercial-authorization dependency policy
commercial_risk_policy.source_boundary: All declared dependencies must have audit evidence showing no commercial authorization, subscription, membership, trial-only, or proprietary-use boundary is required.
